Move Tags Info
value: About moving tags: We define a tag as a part of the release title between round or square brackets. If the release title contains tags then these options will move those tags and their brackets to the end of the release title. Moving only the first tags will try to detect where the actual title of the release begins, and move only the tags that are found before that point. Enabling both options will enable moving of all tags.

name: Move first tags to end of release title
